name: Exec Cluster E16: Wiring Order (Full Executor Chain)
description: Tests: mandatory executor wiring order — long_and_short_zone first, then position_size, then stop_loss + take_profit + trailing_stop. Validates no reporters in strategy (tearsheet auto-generated).
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E16: Wiring Order
# Tests: correct executor sequence, all exit types combined
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: Donchian breakout with trend filter ===
donchian = donchian_channel(src.h, src.l, window=20)
upper = donchian.donchian_upper >> 1
lower = donchian.donchian_lower >> 1

adx_val = adx(src.h, src.l, 14)
trending = (adx_val >> 1) > 25

# Persistent breakout signals (S35 lag consistency)
long_sig = (close > upper) and trending
short_sig = (close < lower) and trending

# === WIRING ORDER (E16) ===
# Step 1: Signal executor (REQUIRED, FIRST)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_sig, short_entry=short_sig)

# Step 2: Position sizing (REQUIRED, exactly one)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=15)

# Step 3: Exit conditions (OPTIONAL, any combo)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=5)
take_profit(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=12)

atr_val = atr(src.h, src.l, src.c, 14)
trailing_stop()(distance=atr_val * 2.5)
